case_title: PRIORITY PARKING VS SIDDIQUI, MOHO ADNAN et al

docket_entries.description: THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF PRIORITY PARKING IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT SIDDIQUI, MOHO ADNAN YELLOW CAB CO INC. PLAINTIFF PRIORITY PARKING HAS NOT SUSTAINED ANY DAMAGE FOR WHICH IT CAN SEEK RECOMPENSE. ANY CLAIM WOULD BE SPECULATING AT THIS TIME. ACCORDINGLY, PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM IS DENIED.
